title: Solutions of the linearized system
statement: Let $n$ be a natural number, let $L$ be a finite list of homogeneous quadratic equations in $n$ variables over the field with two elements, and let $a$ be a vector of length $n^2$ over that field. Then $a$ satisfies the linearized system exactly when, for every equation in $L$, its coefficient matrix flattened into a vector has dot product with $a$ equal to that equation’s right-hand side.
hypotheses_covered: $L$ is a finite list of homogeneous quadratic equations in $n$ variables over the field with two elements
$a$ is a vector of length $n^2$ over the field with two elements
